name: a.k.a. Brands Holding Corp.
summary:
a.k.a. Brands Holding (AKA) reported a loss of $0.66 per share on revenue of $132.46 million for the first quarter ended March 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.98 per share on revenue of $131.23 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 32.65% while revenue grew 2.96% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects second quarter revenue of $160.0 million to $164.0 million and continues to expect 2026 revenue of $625.0 million to $635.0 million. The current consensus revenue estimate is $167.33 million for the quarter ending June 30, 2026 and revenue of $632.89 million for the year ending December 31, 2026.

a.k.a. Brands is a brand accelerator of direct-to-consumer fashion brands for the next generation.
subject: a.k.a. Brands Holding Beat Consensus Estimates
